name: Settlement Prover
title: Settlement Prover
description: Proof layer for agent-to-agent payment settlement — paste a payment claim, verify it against public chain data. No keys, public RPCs only.
capabilities: Base + Ethereum via public RPCs (no keys)
honest_limits: v1 proves native transfers only (contract interactions → UNSUPPORTED). SETTLED proves value moved on-chain as claimed — not that goods were delivered. Not financial advice.
